analysis: The `locale()` method retrieves an iterator from the collection returned by `applicationLocales()` and calls `next()` directly without any prior check. The only exception declared for `next()` is `NoSuchElementException`, which occurs when the iterator has no more elements. Since there is no validation for an empty collection (e.g., using `hasNext()` before calling `next()`), the exception is not avoided in this context.
remark: `NoSuchElementException` is triggered when `applicationLocales()` returns an empty collection, resulting in an iterator with no elements. The lack of a `hasNext()` check before calling `next()` leaves this exception unhandled.
